answer: Latency-decay identity maturity: each new identity starts in a probation kernel and earns standing only through slow, capped interactions over time. A lotus of pending actions can't be rushed—early actions carry near-zero weight for reputation or payouts. To bridge many identities into trusted status simultaneously, an attacker must park capital in escrow for weeks per identity, paying continuous holding costs, and the per-identity cost stays flat rather than scaling down with volume.
